name: Ura Keiichi
source:
The protagonist, known as "K". In his late twenties. A self-righteous genius (and pervert) Veil designer who is extremely particular about his work; he has the skill, but can only create lewd Veils with lots of exposure.

He used to work in NS's Veil development department, but his obsessive design fixations and personality effectively got him fired. He now calls himself a freelance Solace Veil designer, running a lab in the slums and scraping by on barely legal business.

[From DLsite, translated]
